pos.personaBrief: Rangnick says 'just having the ball ourselves doesn't make sense' and Leipzig waited for opponents to leave their mouse hole, winning the ball high to counter; Nagelsmann added possession later, but the core is transition-based.

pro.personaBrief: Rangnick hates square and back passes, laser passes to Forsberg, immediate breakthroughs after turnovers with the pressing players already in motion; Salzburg relied on long balls.

est.personaBrief: Press is organized by rehearsed triggers and traps, but play clusters near the ball, strikers drop to connect, wingers come inside and Nagelsmann used heavy rotations; the ball-far side is abandoned.

lar.personaBrief: Leipzig used outside-in wingers, half-space penetrator Forsberg, central rotations with wing-backs moving infield, and traps pushed opponents out wide; attack is vertical and central.

blo.personaBrief: Core of the school: counter-pressing, high press from the first pass with four pressers, defence pushed up as high as possible, regains in the attacking third.

mar.personaBrief: Rangnick's Leipzig back line marked strikers and Marsch's Salzburg presses man-oriented 2v1; Hasenhuttl's press was trigger-based and zonal, so mixed but leaning man-oriented in the press.

pla.personaBrief: A fixed, drilled model with players recruited to fit it; the same press is applied to opponents, with Marsch and Rangnick imposing the method on arrival.

res.personaBrief: Heavy metal football is meant to overwhelm and entertain; they play to win and press until the end, not to settle for draws or shut games down.

sis.personaBrief: The system and pressing method are the star; players are recruited to fit it and everyone presses, and Marsch's players are cycled out at 22.

jog.personaBrief: Recruits are physically strong, quick and young, with a big physical output required; lightning-fast strikers and intensity are essential.

bas.personaBrief: Youngest recruiter in Europe (average 21), Marsch's database kicks players out at 22, academy pathway via Liefering; youth is the model.

lid.personaBrief: Coach-driven method with strict demands, yet Nagelsmann says 70 percent is social competence and players describe a supportive but loud leader; Marsch's halftime talk shows emotional leadership.
